hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); echo "Cerebro online. $COUNT memories loaded."; echo ''; echo "$RESULT"; if [ -s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log" ]; then echo ''; echo '--- CEREBRO GC EVICTIONS (review and re-add if needed) ---'; tail -1 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log"; fi; else echo 'Cerebro: no brain initialized for this project. Run: cerebro init'; fi

COUNT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Cerebro online. %d memories loaded."}' "$COUNT"; else printf '{"systemMessage": "Cerebro: no brain initialized. Run: cerebro init"}'; fi

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); echo "Cerebro online. $COUNT memories loaded."; echo ''; echo "$RESULT"; fi

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); echo "Cerebro online. $COUNT memories loaded."; echo ''; echo "$RESULT"; if [ -s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log" ]; then echo ''; echo '--- CEREBRO GC EVICTIONS (review and re-add if needed) ---'; tail -1 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log"; fi; fi

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); echo "Cerebro online. $COUNT memories loaded."; echo ''; echo "$RESULT"; if [ -s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log" ]; then echo ''; echo '--- CEREBRO GC EVICTIONS (review and re-add if needed) ---'; tail -1 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-gc.log"; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"session_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -z "$SID" ]; then SID=default; fi; S="/tmp/cerebro-primed-$SID"; [ -f "$S" ] && exit 0; touch "$S"; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); echo "Cerebro online. $COUNT memories loaded."; echo ''; echo "$RESULT"; fi

INPUT=$(cat); SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"session_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); rm -f "/tmp/cerebro-primed-$SID"; echo "$(date -Iseconds) compaction completed" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-compact.log" 2>/dev/null; true
